dict.string: SUBQUERY ( extensionItems, $item, SUBQUERY ($item.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url" || ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.plain-text" || ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image" || ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf" ).@count >= 1 AND SUBQUERY ($item.attachments, $a, ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image" || ANY $a.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf" ).@count <= 4 ).@count >= 1
